response.justification: The candidate is an experienced software developer with a strong web/full-stack background, but is a poor fit for this embedded networking security role. He lacks the mandatory native-level Japanese proficiency, has no demonstrated Linux kernel investigation/modification experience, and shows no background in networking protocols (L2/L3, MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP/NETCONF) or embedded firmware for switch products. His C experience is limited to a brief 7-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, falling well short of the strong UNIX C proficiency required.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software development experience across web, mobile, and systems
Some low-level/performance experience (DLang low-latency services, C/C++ at National Instruments)
Strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, teaching/mentoring)
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency — a hard requirement for this role
No embedded networking, security protocols, or Linux kernel modification experience
C programming experience is minimal and outdated; career focus is web/TypeScript
